sentences.en: The Banu Hilal that came to North Africa heavily intermixed with local Berbers.
sentences.zh: 班尤·希尔阿尔人来到北非后，与当地的柏柏尔人混杂在一起。

sentences.en: The Arab populations that came to North Africa were absorbed by Berbers through intermixing.
sentences.zh: 来到北非的阿拉伯人口通过与柏柏尔人的混居被后者吸收了。

sentences.en: The cultures of the East and West have begun to intermix in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，东西方文化开始相互交融。
